# The Virtual Instructor

> A comprehensive platform offering free and member-exclusive art lessons across drawing, painting, and digital media with live instruction and structured courses.

The Virtual Instructor provides beginner to advanced art education through video tutorials, live classes, and structured courses. The site covers traditional mediums (pencil, watercolor, oil, acrylic, pastel, charcoal) and digital tools (Photoshop, Procreate) with a focus on practical techniques, fundamentals, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Drawing Techniques
- Painting Techniques
- Watercolor
- Acrylic Painting
- Oil Painting
- Pencil Drawing
- Colored Pencils
- Digital Art
- Art Fundamentals
- Portrait Drawing
- Landscape Painting
- Mixed Media
- Photoshop
- Procreate
- Live Classes

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://thevirtualinstructor.com): TheVirtualInstructor.com homepage featuring free art lessons in drawing, painting, watercolor, and gouache.
- [Art Courses](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/art-courses): Member art courses including drawing, painting, and architecture lessons with video instruction.
- [Explore Art Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/explore-art-lessons): Directory of art lessons across mediums including digital art with Photoshop and Procreate.

## Drawing Lessons

- [Drawing Lessons - Learn How to Draw](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/freedrawinglessons.html): Free drawing lessons covering pencil, colored pencils, pastel, and pen-and-ink techniques.
- [Pencil Drawing Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/pencil-drawing-lessons): Pencil drawing courses with graphite techniques, portrait drawing, and realistic rendering fundamentals.
- [Colored Pencil Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/colored-pencil-lessons): Colored pencil courses featuring Prismacolor and Polychromos with bird and landscape lessons.
- [Charcoal Drawing Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/charcoal-drawing-lessons): Charcoal drawing courses covering portrait, figure, and animal drawing with graphite techniques.
- [Pen and Ink Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/pen-and-ink-lessons): Pen and ink drawing lessons including line-and-wash and architecture with Zebra pens.

## Painting Lessons

- [Painting Lessons - Learn How to Paint](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/freepaintinglessons.html): Free painting lessons in watercolor, acrylic, oil, and pastel with fundamental techniques.
- [Watercolor Painting Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/watercolor-painting-lessons): Watercolor and gouache painting lessons with line-and-wash technique and landscape painting.
- [Acrylic Painting Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/acrylic-painting-lessons): Acrylic painting courses covering landscapes, animals, and still-life with step-by-step tutorials.
- [Oil Painting Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/oil-painting-lessons): Oil painting lessons including water-mixable oils for landscapes, still-life, and portraits.
- [Pastel Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/pastel-lessons): Pastel drawing courses with soft pastels, oil pastels, and animal portrait techniques.

## Specialized Instruction

- [Digital Art Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/digital-art-lessons): Digital art courses covering Photoshop, Procreate, and iPad Pro painting and drawing.
- [Mixed Media Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/mixed-media-lessons): Mixed media courses combining watercolor, colored pencils, pen and ink, and Posca markers.
- [Art Fundamentals](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/art-fundamentals): Art fundamentals reference covering color theory, elements of art, and design principles.

## Live Classes & Community

- [Learn Live](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/learn-live): Live weekly art classes with instructors Matt and Ashley covering drawing and painting techniques.
- [The Members Minute Preview](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/the-members-minute-preview): Members-only video episodes with art critique, artist feedback, and technique demonstrations.
- [The Community at The Virtual Instructor](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/community-at-the-virtual-instructor.html): Community forums and member critique platform for discussion and user engagement.

## Optional

- [Art Lesson Plans](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/visual-art-lesson-plans): Visual arts curriculum and lesson plans for secondary education covering multiple mediums.
